subject: Close the five Word threads with the outcome
description: Whichever branch ran, close ch1 15/18/20, ch2 66/69, ch3 127, ch4 177 and ch5 207 in the P0043 ledger with the decision and its reason. If A, the resolution is that the claim was withdrawn and why. If B/C, it is the measured delta. Do not close them as 'done' without a recorded reason -- these five are the clearest example in the corpus of a thread whose answer is a project decision rather than an edit.
